cross_validation_detail.method: 2025 DUKA real M1 -> hourly returns vs FXTM MT5 H1 returns; MT5 index relabelled by offset k to convert server time to UTC; offsets -6..+7 h

minute_identity.conclusion: each calendar day carries exactly 1440 bars stamped at 00:00..23:59; a `sec` value is the minute-offset of the bar inside its calendar day

bar_timestamp_type: minute-offset within a calendar day (day + sec)

bar_close_definition.why: no provider documentation is available offline; the in-repo parser never states open vs close; downloading the provider spec is forbidden by this task
bar_close_definition.structural_evidence: stamps run 00:00..23:59 with exactly 1440 per day and no 24:00/86400 stamp, which is consistent with an INTERVAL-START (open) label, but this is an inference and NOT a proof
bar_close_definition.independent_minute_validation: IMPOSSIBLE with available data: DUKA candles end 2026-08-03, FXTM M1 starts 2026-08-04 (no overlap); the tick semantics of the 9same provider are already UNRESOLVED and are out of scope

data_integrity_findings.meaning: about a third of 2025 rows are flat placeholder bars (O=H=L=C, vol=0); 46 of 320 calendar days are fully flat. Any consumer must filter these or every summary statistic is diluted.
data_integrity_findings.cross_validation_failure: hourly returns of DUKA-2025 and FXTM-2025 show ~0 correlation at every offset tested (-6..+7 h). Per task section 12 this is NOT interpreted as 'the timestamps are wrong'; it is reported as 'independent verification did not succeed'.

must_not: be treated as UTC-confirmed for minute-level work
